title: Save stays disabled when the correct password for an encrypted EC private key is entered (RSA works)
line: The Wi-Fi/Ethernet 802.1x TLS editor now enables Save when the correct password for an EC (non-RSA) private key is entered.
explanation: When the QCA dependency was replaced with OpenSSL (98769afc7, Plasma 6.7), QCA's canDecrypt() was translated as 'the key is RSA'. So a private key the password really opens counted as invalid unless it was RSA, while a wrong password fell through to the final 'valid' and enabled Save. The change treats any key that PEM or PKCS#12 decoding opens with the password as valid, in both the widget editor and the QML editor.

commits.message:
editor: accept any private key type the password decrypts

The 802.1x TLS private key check only counted a decrypted key as valid
when it was RSA, so Save stayed disabled with the correct password for
an EC key. Treat any key that PEM or PKCS#12 decoding opens as valid.

BUG: 527463

media.caption: Master: EC key ec-key.pem with its correct password 123456, Save stays disabled
With the fix: same fields and password, Save is enabled
